name: ilands-skills
description: iLands creation & platform skills for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, pi, OpenClaw, Hermes). Skills call the `dl` CLI, which proxies media generation and iLands platform APIs billed to your iLands wallet — no vendor API keys on your machine.

plugins.name: dl
plugins.description: Creation skills — image / video / music / TTS / lipsync / audio / research / stock media. Calls the `dl` CLI (npm i -g @pawlogic/dl && dl login). Any logged-in iLands user can use these.

plugins.name: ilands
plugins.description: iLands platform skills — publish content, bounties, social interaction, service listings, audience analysis. Anyone can install; access is gated server-side by your iLands account role.
